conditional_clauses.note: The PoSH Act, 2013 requires an Internal Committee at any workplace with ten or more employees.
An exclusivity obligation operating during the employment, which Section 27 of the Contract Act permits.
Stock options or variable pay form part of the package and need their own terms.

mandatory_legal_checks: OSH Code 2020 S.6(1)(f) — the employer MUST issue a letter of appointment to every employee
Code on Wages 2019 S.2(y) — allowances excluded from wages above one-half of total remuneration are added back
Code on Wages 2019 S.17 — monthly wages payable before the seventh day of the following month
PoSH Act 2013 S.4 — Internal Committee mandatory at ten or more employees
Contract Act 1872 S.27 — a post-employment restraint is void unless it protects confidentiality or goodwill
_authoring_note: CORE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_001 is required rather than conditional: it was first written as conditional on `include_arbitration`, which nothing derives, so the clause could never have appeared. Dead conditions are the failure mode this library has been audited for.
